caption: The drawing depicts a sleeveless vest with a high, wide collar. The vest is rendered in shades of pale blue with subtle hints of purple and is adorned with a delicate small yellow dotted pattern across the front. There are six dark round buttons running vertically down the center, securing the vest. The interior lining, visible at the armholes and along the inside front opening, is red. The vest features two horizontal, slit-style pockets placed symmetrically on either side near the waist area. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or details present.
title: Man's Waistcoat
